github_lfs_policy.note: Total dataset size (2.9 GB) exceeds the 1 GB free LFS storage quota. The push may still succeed if the user's account has paid LFS data packs, but a quota-exceeded error is the most likely outcome. If the LFS push fails, the manifest + redownload script provide a complete fallback recovery path via Google Drive.

recovery_procedure: 1. Clone the GitHub repo: git clone https://github.com/AeroMSK/ecg_outputs.git
2. The notebook is committed directly to git - no LFS needed.
3a. If LFS push succeeded: git lfs pull  (downloads CPSC.zip + Zheng parts)
3b. If LFS push failed (quota exceeded): bash ECG_CPSC2018/manifests/redownload_source_files.sh
5. Verify integrity: SHA256s are recorded above; the recombine script verifies automatically.
